info.name: ApparelDesk API
info.description:
# ApparelDesk API — Postman Collection

Fashion retail management platform (storefront + admin) ka complete API suite.

## Quick Start (recommended order)

| Step | Request | Kya hota hai |
| ---- | ------- | ------------ |
| 1 | Health ▸ Health Check | API up hai confirm karein |
| 2 | Auth ▸ Login (Admin) | `{{adminToken}}` auto-save |
| 3 | Auth ▸ Login (Customer) | `{{token}}` auto-save |
| 4 | Products ▸ Public List | `{{lastProductId}}` auto-save |
| 5 | Contacts ▸ List Vendors | `{{lastVendorId}}` auto-save |
| 6 | Orders ▸ Checkout | `{{lastOrderId}}` auto-save |

## Demo Accounts

- **Admin:** admin@appareldesk.com / admin123
- **Customer:** customer@appareldesk.com / customer123

## Seeded Coupons

FIRST20, SAVE10, FLAT500, APPAREL20, WELCOME10, SAVE500

## Auth

Bearer JWT — collection-level auth `{{token}}` (customer) use karta hai; admin requests pe request-level override `{{adminToken}}` hai. Public requests pe `noauth` set hai.

## Base URL

- Local: `http://localhost:3001/api`
- Production: `https://appareldesk-api.onrender.com/api` (`baseUrl` variable badal dein)
